name: Sarno Method / Tension Myositis Syndrome (TMS, Mindbody Syndrome)
founders: John E. Sarno, MD (Professor of Rehabilitation Medicine, NYU School of Medicine / Rusk Institute of Rehabilitation Medicine; 1923-2017)
PPD/TMS Peer Network (peer-run nonprofit, Brookline MA; TMS Wiki 2009)
Alan Gordon, LCSW (free Pain Recovery Program hosted on TMS Wiki)
founded_year_range: 1973-1982: concept developed at Rusk in the 1970s (approximate); first book Mind Over Back Pain 1982; Healing Back Pain 1991; TMS Wiki/Peer Network Jan 2009
cost_summary: Books ~USD 10-18 (paperback, 2026). TMS Wiki Structured Educational Program (6 wk) and Alan Gordon's Pain Recovery Program are free (donation-supported nonprofit). TMS physicians/therapists are fee-for-service, roughly USD 150-300/hr (US market range, unverified per practitioner).
mechanisms: autonomic/nervous system dysregulation (sympathetic overdrive, "stuck in fight-or-flight")
neuroplastic/learned pain (brain-generated danger signal / predictive processing)
mechanism_summary: Unconscious repressed emotion, chiefly rage from childhood, personality (perfectionism, "goodism") and life pressures, threatens to reach awareness. The brain creates physical symptoms as a distraction (defence). Sarno's original physiology: the brain uses the autonomic nervous system to cause mild, harmless ischaemia in muscles, nerves and tendons. This was never demonstrated. The "symptom imperative": if a symptom is treated physically, the brain substitutes another, producing "TMS equivalents" (IBS, headache, GERD, tinnitus, skin, anxiety/depression). Fear of structural diagnoses perpetuates the pain. The cure is knowledge: accepting the psychological diagnosis removes the distraction's purpose. Successors (Schubiner, Gordon) recast it as neuroplastic/brain-generated pain and threat conditioning.
techniques: physician diagnosis ruling out structural disease and confirming TMS tender points
accepting the psychological diagnosis and rejecting structural explanations
daily reflection and journaling on childhood, personality and current stressors (15-30 min)
resuming all normal physical activity; stopping physical therapy and treatments
TMS Wiki 6-week Structured Educational Program (reading, journaling, meditation, forum)
Alan Gordon Pain Recovery Program (fear reduction, somatic tracking)
peer support forum and drop-in chat
mainstream_notes: Practised within NYU Rusk Institute, but the diagnosis was rejected by mainstream medicine. Sarno said "99.999%" of physicians rejected it, and an NYU Langone pain specialist called his views "on the fringe" (2017). Wikipedia labels TMS a pseudomedical diagnosis. It is not in any guideline by name. Endorsed by Andrew Weil (the reported Mehmet Oz endorsement is unverified). Practised by a small physician network (Schechter, Schubiner, Sopher, Rashbaum). Its indirect influence is large: it is the root of PRT, EAET, psychophysiologic-disorder clinics (e.g. Donnino's PSRT at Beth Israel Deaconess) and apps such as Curable and Pathways.
insurance_notes: The method is not reimbursed as such. Visits to TMS-oriented physicians and psychotherapy with TMS therapists can be billed under standard E/M and psychotherapy codes, though many therapists are out-of-network. Books and the free wiki programs are self-funded.

key_trials.citation: Schechter D, Smith AP, Beck J, Roach J, Karim R, Azen S. Outcomes of a mind-body treatment program for chronic back pain with no distinct structural pathology--a case series of patients diagnosed and treated as tension myositis syndrome. Altern Ther Health Med 2007;13(5):26-35. PMID 17900039
key_trials.design: Uncontrolled case series, single physician's office (Los Angeles), 2002-03; follow-up 3-12 mo (Sarno method itself)
key_trials.finding: Mean pain VAS -52% average, -35% worst, -65% least (P<.0001); SF-12 physical +9; less medication, more activity. No control group; investigator allegiance.

key_trials.citation: Hsu MC, Schubiner H, Lumley MA, Stracks JS, Clauw DJ, Williams DA. Sustained pain reduction through affective self-awareness in fibromyalgia: a randomized controlled trial. J Gen Intern Med 2010;25(10):1064-70. PMID 20532650
key_trials.design: RCT vs wait-list, blinded assessor (Sarno-derived affective self-awareness; descendant, not Sarno method)
key_trials.finding: At 6 mo, lower pain, better function and higher tender-point threshold; 45.8% had >=30% pain reduction vs 0% of controls.

key_trials.citation: Burger AJ, Lumley MA, Carty JN, et al. The effects of a novel psychological attribution and emotional awareness and expression therapy for chronic musculoskeletal pain: a preliminary, uncontrolled trial. J Psychosom Res 2016;81:1-8. PMID 26800632
key_trials.finding: Large pre-post improvements in pain, interference, depression and distress maintained at 6 mo; ~2/3 improved >=30% in pain.

key_trials.citation: Lumley MA, Schubiner H, Lockhart NA, et al. Emotional awareness and expression therapy, cognitive behavioral therapy, and education for fibromyalgia: a cluster-randomized controlled trial. Pain 2017;158(12):2354-63. PMID 28796118
key_trials.finding: EAET did not differ from education on primary outcome (pain severity) but beat it on secondary outcomes (d 0.29-0.45). Did not differ from CBT on most outcomes; more >=50% pain responders (22.5% vs 8.3%).

key_trials.citation: Donnino MW, Thompson GS, Mehta S, et al. Psychophysiologic symptom relief therapy for chronic back pain: a pilot randomized controlled trial. Pain Rep 2021;6(3):e959. PMID 34589642
key_trials.design: Pilot RCT: PSRT vs MBSR vs usual care (descendant)
key_trials.finding: At 26 wk, RMDQ improved more with PSRT (9.5 to 3.3); 63.6% pain-free vs 25% (MBSR) and 16.7% (usual care).

key_trials.citation: Ashar YK, Gordon A, Schubiner H, et al. Effect of Pain Reprocessing Therapy vs Placebo and Usual Care for Patients With Chronic Back Pain: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA Psychiatry 2022;79(1):13-23. PMID 34586357
key_trials.design: RCT, 3 arms with fMRI, 1-yr follow-up (descendant PRT)
key_trials.finding: Post-treatment pain 1.18 vs 2.84 (placebo) vs 3.13 (usual care); 66% pain-free or nearly vs 20%/10%; effects largely maintained at 1 yr.

key_trials.citation: Yarns BC, Jackson NJ, Alas A, Melrose RJ, Lumley MA, Sultzer DL. Emotional Awareness and Expression Therapy vs Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Chronic Pain in Older Veterans: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA Netw Open 2024;7(6):e2415842. PMID 38869899
key_trials.design: RCT, EAET vs CBT, VA Greater Los Angeles, 6-mo follow-up (descendant EAET)
key_trials.finding: EAET superior to CBT on pain severity post-treatment (-1.59) and at 6 mo (-1.01); >=30% pain reduction 63% vs 17%.

controversy: Wikipedia labels it a pseudomedical diagnosis, and NYU colleagues called it "on the fringe." Criticisms: unfalsifiable constructs (repressed rage, symptom imperative); an untested ischaemia hypothesis; no controlled trial of the method itself; a claimed ~85% cure rate never verified by studies; over-application risking missed structural disease (Rainville); advice to ignore imaging and stop physical therapy; perceived victim-blaming for contested illnesses; reliance on celebrity anecdotes (Stern, Stossel, who reported relapses); natural recovery of back pain as a confound. Descendant PRT/EAET trials are allegiance-led and test different mechanisms.

indicators.source: NYT obituary as cited by Shelf Awareness

indicators.value: All the Rage: Saved by Sarno (Larry David, Howard Stern, Andrew Weil)
TMS Wiki / PPD-TMS Peer Network founded January 2009

popularity.reach_estimate: ~1-5 million people: >1 million books sold (multiple readers per copy, plus decades of word of mouth and media such as Howard Stern and 20/20), plus Sarno's clinic patients (>10,000 self-reported) and TMS Wiki visitors (forum ~14k members, many more readers).
popularity.method_notes: Trajectory anchored on documented events: 1970s Rusk clinic; 1982, 1991, 1998 and 2006 book releases (Healing Back Pain as the inflection point); TMS Wiki founding in 2009; Sarno's retirement ~2012 (year not re-verified); 2016 documentary; June 2017 death with NYT/WaPo obituaries (peak media); 2021-22 PRT JAMA Psychiatry trial and Gordon's The Way Out, renewing interest. The level then declines slightly as successor brands (Curable, PRT, Sachs) absorb attention. Google Trends and Reddit (r/TMSHealing) counts were not retrieved because the web search budget was exhausted. The levels are judgement-based on those anchors. Reach is the >1M books sold times a readers-per-copy factor, plus clinic and online users. Forum counts were re-verified on 2026-10-12.
